items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: there was Charlie Taylor, the colored violinist -- they had a great band out at Egg Harbor... He used to say, 'Aw, man, you guys got a really good band,' you know.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Claude Hopkins band -- it's a little club down there. I ran across -- there's been a lot of good musicians in Philly at that time -- in Atlantic City at that time. There was the Egg Harbor Club there with a great band in it, and there was Charlie Taylor, the colored violinist -- they had a great band out at Egg Harbor. Big band there. And you had a chance to really here -- as young as I was, I heard some great musicians down there in Atlantic City. Then I have to go back home -- go back to school, you know.
You were still in high school at this time.
